title: [Error] Master - follower issue with Huawei P40 lite
body:
Hi,
I have purchased a new Huawei P40 lite mobile phone that should become the master for group sync.
We are using Dexcom G6 senzors and transmitters.

Due to the fact that this mobile comes without the Google Play Services (US banned the cooperation), xdrip+ did not work.
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/67560751/86181395-36c52180-bb2e-11ea-8fe3-3f0527532ac4.png)

In order to install the missing Google Play Services, I have followed the steps and installed the files from the youtube link:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pdgGkHEe7V4

Everything has been successfully installed and Google services seem to work properly.

Afterwards I installed the latest xdrip+ version, the xDrip-plus-20200611-9cfe91f.apk and due to the fact that another mobile is currently set as "master", the Huawei mobile has been set as follower, just to test if he is receiving the data.

Unfortunatelly, it is not receiving the data as follower, therefore I have not even tried to configure it as the master. Here is the screen shot of the log:

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/67560751/86183222-d59f4d00-bb31-11ea-9e5b-c72ce9c03bd2.png)

Here are also the additional settings for xdrip+ on the phone:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/67560751/86184590-cc63af80-bb34-11ea-98a1-b1a0ee1f59d3.png)
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/67560751/86184616-d5ed1780-bb34-11ea-802a-bfe2d470fa56.png)

and the follower settings in xdrip+:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/67560751/86184632-dedde900-bb34-11ea-8112-75160b1fea8c.png)
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/67560751/86184648-e69d8d80-bb34-11ea-9e8e-3835cac2ad35.png)

and the system status:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/67560751/86184674-f1f0b900-bb34-11ea-8ffc-b2b50718ee30.png)
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/67560751/86184691-f87f3080-bb34-11ea-8abb-0ff1e36cf57d.png)
